say:4:1910840004:1.text: I don't want to frighten you. Why not sit down? I once made a promise to give us a chance to talk.
say:4:1910840004:1.source_cn: 我不想让你害怕，为什么不坐下来呢？我曾经许下一个承诺，...

say:5:1910840005:1.text: Sit, my dear. There's nothing to fear when you're facing yourself.
say:5:1910840005:1.source_cn: 坐吧，亲爱的我，面对自身，没什么好怕的。

say:6:1910840006:1.text: For a moment, I thought I was you. I saw so many memories. Mister Calix's, Grandma's, the Deepfolk's...
say:6:1910840006:1.source_cn: 有一瞬间……我以为我就是你。我看到好多记忆，卡律先生的...

say:7:1910840007:1.text: Because we <style="highlight2">were always one</style>. You can hear me because the time of our reunion is near.

say:8:1910840008:1.text: The Shallowfolk, the Deepfolk, and their countless names and memories... They are all me.
say:8:1910840008:1.source_cn: 浅海裔，深海裔，无数的名字，无数的记忆，都是我。

say:9:1910840009:1.text: You are my fragments scattered in the Shallowsea... a piece of a god. The children of the Deepsea are the same as well.
say:9:1910840009:1.source_cn: 你们是我散落在浅海的碎片，是神明的一部分，那些深海的孩...

say:10:1910840010:1.text: Tell me, my dear. Why are you the only one who refuses to return? Your family, your memories, and everything you love are here. Why do you resist yourself?
say:10:1910840010:1.source_cn: 告诉我，亲爱的我，为什么只有你不愿意回来？你的家人，你...

say:11:1910840011:1.text: Because... I am not you. How could I possibly be you?
say:11:1910840011:1.source_cn: 因为我……不是你。我不是你，我怎么可能是你？！

say:12:1910840012:1.text: Grandma, Morin, Mister Calix...! They're just like me. They're their own people! Give them back, please! I'm begging you. If you really are a god, give them back!
say:12:1910840012:1.source_cn: 阿嬷，沫霖姐姐，卡律先生……！他们和我一样，都是独立的...

say:13:1910840013:1.text: Oh, poor thing, you're trembling. Shh... Don't be scared. Come here, you need a hug.
say:13:1910840013:1.source_cn: 你在发抖，真可怜，嘘……嘘……别害怕，过来，你需要一个拥抱。

say:14:1910840014:1.source_cn: 不许用阿嬷的方式说话！

say:15:1910840015:1.text: Why not? That was my way of speaking all along. I remember singing lullabies to you in the night. I remember the terror of the glowing tide swallowing me, and the pain of hurting myself so I wouldn't hurt you.
say:15:1910840015:1.source_cn: 为什么不呢？那本来就是我的语言呀，我记得在夜里为你唱童...

say:16:1910840016:1.text: I remember Calix opening a wound to stay conscious... but he didn't actually need to do that because he's me as well.
say:16:1910840016:1.source_cn: 我记得卡律为了保持清醒而流血的样子，但他其实不必那么做...

say:17:1910840017:1.text: You know that, don't you? At this point, everything I ever lived through is mirrored inside your mind as well.
say:17:1910840017:1.source_cn: 你知道这一点，对不对？到了现在的时刻，我曾经历的一切，...

say:19:1910840019:1.text: You know I want to reunite with my people and complete myself. Just as you are longing now to be reunited with Coralia.
say:19:1910840019:1.source_cn: 你知道我想以完整的身份与自己的亲人团聚——正如你现在所...

say:20:1910840020:1.text: Dura... she is your sister. One of the few of your kind you have left...
say:20:1910840020:1.source_cn: 艾雅，她是你的妹妹，你所剩不多的族人……

say:21:1910840021:1.text: We bear a curse... the two of us. I don't want to hurt her after my fall from grace, nor do I want to add more scars to her already battered soul as she continued to kill her kin.
say:21:1910840021:1.source_cn: 我们背负了诅咒，我不想在堕落后伤害她，也不想让她遍体鳞...

say:22:1910840022:1.text: You know that kind of pain and despair.
say:22:1910840022:1.source_cn: 而你了解那种绝望和痛苦。

say:23:1910840023:1.text: Just like Mister Calix when he had to fight his own family. He was in so much pain then.
say:23:1910840023:1.source_cn: 就像卡律先生，不得不对他的族裔举起武器……他当时很痛苦。

say:24:1910840024:1.text: I want to be reunited with my sister. It's a chance that only comes around every five hundred years. A single, fleeting moment of clarity...
say:24:1910840024:1.source_cn: 我想与她团聚，五百年一次的机会，唯一一瞬的清醒。

say:25:1910840025:1.text: And so we... the Merfolk get to live free and happy lives for five hundred years. And after five hundred years, we will become you...
say:25:1910840025:1.source_cn: 而我们……海裔……可以幸福自在地存在五百年。五百年之后...

say:26:1910840026:1.text: Then after that, new Merfolk will be born, and you will sleep inside our bodies until our heartbeats become your heartbeat once more.
say:26:1910840026:1.source_cn: 之后，新的海裔再次出生，你会沉睡在我们的身体里，直到我...

say:27:1910840027:1.text: In the end, we become one...

say:29:1910840029:1.text: I am you. I am the Shallowfolk and the Deepfolk. I am the master of the Tidewarden, the ocean, and the cycle. I am my own parent, spouse, and child.
say:29:1910840029:1.source_cn: 我是你，是浅海裔，是深海裔，是波涛长者的主人，是大洋与...

say:30:1910840030:1.text: <style="highlight2">I am Oceana, Goddess of the Sea and Birth. And so are you.</style>

say:31:1910840031:1.text: Come home, child. Or should I say, my dear little me. We are one and the same.
say:31:1910840031:1.source_cn: 回来吧，孩子，或者——亲爱的我。在我这里，这两个词是同...

say:32:1910840032:1.text: Let us be reunited with our family.
say:32:1910840032:1.source_cn: 让我们都与自己的家人团聚吧。
